text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, our summer camp begins. We'll be
spending the next few
weeks getting in
some good training by the beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Or at least, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have a sudden urge to prove a theory
that I've been losing sleep
formulating. But
before we start the experiment—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how are you feeling?! Your body
temperature? Hours slept?
Food
consumed?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your condition could greatly affect the
results, you see. As such, I
must record this
data before the experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... My theory concerns the
increase of running speeds. You
could call
it another form of training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though, you'll be the one putting in the
work.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Don't worry, this time you'll stay
conscious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, first we'll measure the energy
consumption of your organs
under extreme
stress. Then we'll crank things up step by
step—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon continues talking to herself.
Looks like she has no intention
of
partaking in normal training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Which is why it's about time you stopped
subscribing to the tired
notion that
summer camp means a montage of us
running along the
beach. Try to think
outside the box.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no time for us to be twiddling our
thumbs when we should be
pursuing the
limits of speed. Now, let us begin the
experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll utilize the incline of this road to
stimulate your
cardiopulmonary functions!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To get good data, you'll need to run to
the beach and back at least
three times.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is your measuring instrument ready? It'll
record your oxygen levels
once a lap, so
don't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Also, no matter how exhausted you
get—don't stop running. I want
data from
when you're near your limit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What? All you have to do is empty your
mind and run like a hamster
on a wheel!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But you are only a guinea pig, so I'm not
expecting you to run as well
as a hamster.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fear not—I'll be accompanying you.
Someone has to make sure you
don't veer
off course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...And there goes my last hope of escape.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you can do it, Trainer! Lift those
thighs higher! Right—keep
up this pace!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Keep your breathing steady! Otherwise,
you'll make things harder on
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Excellent, are you near your limit?
We still have two laps to
go! Just a little
bit more!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You suffered greater muscle fatigue
than I had expected. Your
legs aren't
shaking, but I can see that you're trying
your best to keep
standing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, let's move on to the next
experiment. I want to collect
data on your
respiratory organs as you run up a slope in
this state.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, this will be a gold mine of data!
This could open the door
to the potential
we seek—the precursor to something
great!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Or, it would've been. Looking at you,
you're not almost at your
limit—you're past
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It appears my calculations were off. Since
we can't get the data right
now, we'll have
to reschedule the experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have no complaints if you wish to
continue. But I'd rather use this
time to
perform another experiment than record
unnecessary data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That said, I don't seem to be carrying
anything useful. Hm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Seawater, you say? Of course, swimming
isn't the only thing you can
do in the
ocean. But what are we to do without the
right tools?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you were thinking of drinking
it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Icing... Considering today's weather, the
temperature of the ocean
must be over
twenty-five degrees Celsius. Not the ideal
temperature
for ice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, your idea is banal yet has its merits.
For instance, I never
would've come up
with that idea myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By focusing the water on your muscle
contractions, we could collect
new
data—No, that would only retain heat.
Hm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! The ocean possesses its own
unique salinity, buoyancy,
and tidal
friction. We must verify how your body will
react to these
elements!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, this is very interesting data indeed.
Not quite enough to prove
my theory...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But if I focus my research in this direction,
then surely a breakthrough
is inevitable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... This will work, I'm sure of
it! Trainer, it's time to
compile the data!
Lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We return to the dorm and begin sifting
through today's data. Of
course, we pull
an all-nighter experimenting as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yawn... A good morning to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I must express my gratitude for your
cooperation. Thanks to you, I was
able to
develop a new medicine based on my
theory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, it's still only on paper. I don't
have my tools here at
camp, so production
will have to wait until we return to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But before that, I'd like to get your
opinion on something. Did you
notice
anything from our research last night?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I especially want to hear about ways to
increase the efficiency of
supplying
oxygen to the muscles during contraction.
Tell me all that
you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, there's a certain value in the
opinion of an amateur. Your
opinions are
novel—even your simple questions spark
my interest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Most importantly, you're the only one who
goes along with my
experiments. I'm
expecting great things from you, my
guinea pig
assistant!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're a capable test subject, and your
perspective is invaluable.
Holistically
speaking, what are you if not my assistant?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Guinea pigs and assistants are equally
invaluable to a researcher like
myself. So if
you ever have an interesting thought,
share it with me!
I'm all ears!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, have I not been? Hm, perhaps we
could call this another step
towards the
potential we seek.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice, Trainer! This single step will
indubitably lead us down a
greater path.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And with that out of the way, let us
resume our experiments! Our time
here is
finite, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I miscalculated yesterday, but this time I'll
work you to the brink of
your limit! Let us
begin, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon makes me run despite my lack of
sleep, and before I know it,
I've reached
my limit once again...
